summary_en: derekchiang's EIP-8141 APPROVE wording fix merged. pdobacz's EIP reserving the EXTENSION (0xae) opcode merged. A pERC-20 native private ERC-20 draft appeared on Magicians. VitalikButerin covered the strawmap's block building pipeline: ePBS lets proposers outsource to a permissionless builder market, though censorship and MEV at the builder layer remain.
